{{Top|fa}} {{Character |type=Criminal |image=[[File:Vizam.png]] |name=Vizam |homeworld=[[Kintan]]''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]'' {{C|French version only}} |birth= |death=[[4 ABY]], [[Tatooine]]''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates the events of {{Film|VI}}, which include Vizam's [[death]] on [[Tatooine]], to [[4 ABY]]. |species=[[Nikto]] {{C|[[Kajain'sa'Nikto]]}}''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]'' |gender=[[Gender|Male]]{{Film|VI}} {{C|[[Disney+]] audio description}} |pronouns=He/him{{HelmetCollectionCite|19|Weapons & Uniforms}} |height= |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes= |skin=[[Color|Orange]] |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=[[Jabba's criminal empire|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's criminal empire]]{{Film|VI}} |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|You said you were interested in a line on some easy money… that still the case, ''Corbus''?''"
"''Depends on how easy, ''Vizam''. And how much.''"
"''How much is a million credits.''"
"''I'm listening.|Vizam contacts Corbus Tyra about a potential job|[[Han Solo & Chewbacca 1|''Han Solo & Chewbacca'' 1]]}} '''Vizam''' was a [[Kajain'sa'Nikto]] [[Gender|male]] who served as [[weapons master]] for the [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba the Hutt]]. Between 8 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]] and [[2 BBY]], Vizam contacted the criminal [[Corbus Tyra]] to let him know that Jabba was offering a million [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] for someone to steal an [[Unidentified urn|urn]] containing the ashes of the Hutt's rival [[Krestrel D'Naran]]. In [[4 ABY]], he was present in the throne room of [[Boba Fett's Palace|Jabba's Palace]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] when the [[droid]]s [[R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO]] arrived to deliver a message from [[Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker]], a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]]. Skywalker stated his desire to see the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] freed from [[Prison|imprisonment]] in the palace and then gifted the droids to Jabba. Vizam later watched a performance by the [[Max Rebo Band]] in the throne room, which ended with the dancer [[Oola]] being dropped through a trap door into a pit containing the [[rancor]] [[Pateesa]]. The [[Nikto]] excitedly watched as the dancer was [[Death|killed]] by Pateesa, after which Skywalker's ally [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] arrived disguised as a [[Boushh|bounty hunter]] with the Solo's ally [[Chewbacca]] as a [[prisoner]]. Vizam and the rest of Jabba's court later hid within the throne room in order to catch Organa attempting to free Solo. Once the smuggler was free, Jabba revealed himself along with Vizam and the others and had Organa and Solo captured. Vizam was again present in the throne room when Skywalker himself arrived, witnessing Jabba drop the [[Jedi]] into the rancor pit only for Skywalker to slay Pateesa. Jabba then demanded that the prisoners be fed to the [[sarlacc]] living in the [[Great Pit of Carkoon]]. Vizam traveled to the pit onboard Jabba's [[LO-KD57|sail barge]], the ''[[Khetanna]]'', but the prisoners fought back against Jabba's thugs once brought to their destination. While Vizam mounted a [[Gi/9 antipersonnel laser cannon|laser cannon]] on the [[Sail barge|barge's]] top deck and opened fire on the [[Bantha-II cargo skiff|skiff]] carrying the prisoners, Skywalker boarded the barge and slew the Nikto with his [[Luke Skywalker's green lightsaber|lightsaber]]. ==Biography== ===Payday for a pal=== {{Quote|I know if he's willing to pay a million credits, I won't be the ''only'' one after it.''"
"''That's true, he sent a crew.''"
"''Anyone I know?''"
"''That depends… do you know ''Han Solo''?|Corbus and Vizam|}} [[File:VizamCorbus-HanSoloChewbacca1.png|thumb|right|300px|Vizam contacted Corbus Tyra after learning about a lucrative opportunity.]] Originally [[Homeworld|from]] the [[planet]] [[Kintan]], the [[Nikto]] [[Gender|male]] Vizam served as [[weapons master]]{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Vintage Collection|packtype=Special Action Figure Set|pack=#152-154: Skiff Guard 3-Pack (Vadain, Vizam, & Brock Staraher)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/Special-3-Action-Figures-Set-The-Vintage-Collection.asp}} for the [[Jabba's criminal empire|criminal empire]] of the [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. At some point between around [[8 BBY]] and [[2 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Han Solo & Chewbacca]]'' to between around [[8 BBY]] and [[2 BBY]]. Vizam learned that Jabba had offered the criminals [[Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca]], and [[Greedo]] one million [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] to go to the planet [[Corellia]] and steal an [[Unidentified urn|urn]] containing the ashes of [[Krestrel D'Naran]], one of the Hutt's rivals. Knowing that he was looking for an easy way to make [[Currency|money]], Vizam then contacted the criminal known as [[Corbus Tyra]][[Han Solo & Chewbacca 5|''Han Solo & Chewbacca'' 5]] via [[hologram]] from a [[cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley]] [[spaceport]] on the planet [[Tatooine]]. After Vizam detailed the job and its reward, Tyra correctly guessed that for that much money there must be other parties also trying to steal the urn, prompting Vizam to ask if Tyra was familiar with Solo. Jabba's [[majordomo]], [[Bib Fortuna]], was aware that Vizam had told Tyra about the job and provided this information to [[Buck Vancto]], a [[marshal]] of the [[Benelex Marshal Service]] who was searching for Solo. Following this lead, Vancto crossed paths with Tyra and arrested him, revealing that he had learned about Vizam's tip off. ===Present at the palace=== In [[4 ABY]], during the [[Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]], Vizam was present in the [[throne]] room of [[Boba Fett's Palace|Jabba's Palace]] on the Tatooine when the [[droid]]s [[R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO]] delivered a message to the Hutt from [[Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker]] of the Rebel Alliance. As Vizam stood next to a [[Jawa]] beside Jabba's dais, a hologram of Skywalker stated his intention to see Solo, who was [[Prison|imprisoned]] in the palace within a block of [[carbonite]], set free. Skywalker then gifted the two droids to Jabba, and they were escorted by several of the Hutt's henchmen from the room. [[File:VizamGauron-RancorPit.png|thumb|left|300px|Vizam eagerly watched the demise of Oola.]] Vizam later viewed a [[music]]al performance by the [[Max Rebo Band]] in the throne room, which ended when the [[Twi'lek]] dancer [[Oola]] refused Jabba's advances. The Hutt dropped the dancer through a trap door into a pit containing his pet [[rancor]], [[Pateesa]].''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]'' Vizam was among the members of the court who rushed forward to the grate above the pit to witness Oola's [[Death|demise]]. [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], an ally of Skywalker, then arrived in the throne room disguised as the [[bounty hunter]] [[Boushh]] and was accepted into the court after delivering Chewbacca as a [[prisoner]] to the Hutt. ===Plot by a princess=== [[File:Luke-DL18.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Vizam (back left corner) witnessed Luke Skywalker threaten Jabba the Hutt.]] Having been tipped off by the bounty hunter [[Boba Fett]], Jabba knew Boushh was not who they seemed''[[Return of the Jedi: Beware the Power of the Dark Side!]]'' and later that [[Standard day|night]], Vizam and the rest of the court hid themselves behind a curtain in the throne room in order to set a trap for her. After they had waited for an [[Standard hour|hour]], Organa crept into the room and freed Solo from the carbonite, Jabba revealed himself along with Vizam and his other allies, who were stood between the pair and the exit, blocking their escape. The Hutt then had Organa and Solo taken captive. With Organa having failed her mission, Skywalker himself arrived at the palace to confront the Hutt. Vizam was seated on the floor of one of the throne room's alcoves among various other resting court members when Skywalker entered the throne room and demanded that Jabba free his friends. Vizam stood to witness the confrontation, which resulted in Skywalker being dropped into the rancor pit after threatening Jabba's life. However, Skywalker managed to slay Pateesa, causing an enraged Jabba to demand that Skywalker, Solo, and Chewbacca be fed to the [[sarlacc]] that dwelled within the [[Great Pit of Carkoon]] on Tatooine. ===Peril at the pit=== [[File:VizamDeath-ROTJ.png|thumb|left|300px|Vizam was killed by Luke Skywalker during the battle at the sarlacc pit.]] To view his prisoners' execution, Jabba traveled to the sarlacc pit on his [[LO-KD57|sail barge]], the ''[[Khetanna]]''. Vizam was also on the [[Sail barge|barge]] while Jabba's prisoners were transported on a [[Bantha-II cargo skiff]] escort. Once the [[skiff]] stopped above the pit, R2-D2 launched Skywalker's [[Luke Skywalker's green lightsaber|lightsaber]] from the barge to the Jedi, who took the blade to defeat Jabba's henchmen and free his friends aboard the skiff. Vizam witnessed the attack and quickly mounted[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (paperback novel)|''Star Wars: Return of the Jedi'' junior novelization]] a [[Gi/9 antipersonnel laser cannon]][[Star Wars: Complete Vehicles (2018)|''Star Wars: Complete Vehicles'' (2018)]] on the sail barge's railing. The Nikto then opened fire on the skiff, which knocked [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]]—an ally of Skywalker's who had been disguised as one of Jabba's men—and the skiff's [[Helm officer|helmsman]], [[Vedain]],''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]'' overboard. Calrissian took hold of the skiff and survived, but the helmsman tumbled into the maw of the sarlacc. Vizam continued firing on the skiff, allowing Skywalker to deflect one of the bolts from the Nikto's [[turret]] into the [[jetpack]] of Fett, incapacitating Fett and contributing in no small part to the hunter's fall into the sarlacc below. Vizam's assault eventually caused the vehicle to drop on one side, after which Skywalker climbed aboard the sail barge and slashed Vizam with his [[lightsaber]], killing him. The Jedi and his allies went on to kill Jabba and destroy the entire sail barge before escaping Tatooine. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|That's a lot of cash for some ashes.''"
"''You have to know Jabba.|Corbus and Vizam|}} [[File:Vizam_Canon.png|thumb|right|300px|Vizam fired enthusiastically with his turret from the ''Khetanna'', so intent on the weapon that he missed Luke Skywalker scaling the barge.]] Vizam was an [[Color|orange]]-skinned [[Kajain'sa'Nikto]], a [[Species|subspecies]] of the Nikto species,''[[Star Wars: Alien Archive]]'' with a flat face. His scaly skin, horns, and facial spikes gave him an intimidating appearance.{{SideshowCite|set=Sideshow Collectibles|pack=Vizam|link=collectibles/star-wars-vizam-sideshow-collectibles-100492}} After learning that Jabba had offered a job to Solo and his crew, Vizam contacted Corbus as a potential rival for Jabba's chosen employees. When Corbus expressed surprise at the amount that the Hutt was offering for the urn, Vizam stated that it was not that surprising if you knew Jabba. Vizam enjoyed grisly executions more than most. When the [[Slavery|enslaved]] girl Oola was being eaten by the rancor, the Nikto chose to move closer to the rancor's pit and watch while bobbing up and down. The disruption of the execution at the Pit of Carkoon spoiled Vizam's day and he began firing from the deck enthusiastically in order try and bring things back under control and earn Jabba's respect. The Nikto was so intent on firing at the skiff that he did not notice Skywalker boarding the sail barge until it was too late, although he demonstrated his confidence and fighting capabilites against Skywalker. ==Equipment== Vizam manned a [[laser cannon]] while aboard Jabba's sail barge. He wore layered blue and tan [[Clothing|shirts]], brown pants, brown [[armor]], a yellow vest, and a protective brown-and-gray [[hat]] made for harsh desert climates. His outfit also included chrome [[gauntlet]]s, a brown [[utility belt]], and black [[boot]]s. On at least one occasion, Vizam also carried a [[DL-18 blaster pistol]], which he kept in a [[holster]] on his belt. ==Behind the scenes== ===Film character=== {{Quote|I would say, 'If I give that guy a full costume, all you have to make are his hands and head.'|Nilo Rodis-Jamero describes the collaboration leading to the creation of the Vizam costume|''[[Star Wars Costumes: The Original Trilogy]]''}} [[File:VizamCostume.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Vizam's costume was made by Phil Tippett's creature design team and Nilo Rodis-Jamero's costume design team.]] Vizam first appeared in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]. The character was created for the film through the combined efforts of [[Phil Tippett]]'s creature design team and [[Nilo Rodis-Jamero]]'s costume design team. During production of the film, Vizam was known as "Nikto #4" and dressed in a costume designed to be similar to some of the other skiff guards. A sketch of Vizam's costume was drawn by Tippett.''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi]]'' The Vizam costume consisted of a navy undergarment covered by a brown [[Wikipedia:Kimono|kimono]] and then a quilted yellow [[Wikipedia:Tabard|tabard]], as well as white pants, gray [[Wikipedia:Vambraces|vambraces]], and a soft hat made of brown-and-gray fabric. The costume's wrist guards were made of plastic, and the cotton jersey that served as the undergarment was dyed navy and smocked to give the clothing a loose, bunched appearance on the arms. In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the character was first identified by name in the [[Star Wars Helmet Collection 19|nineteenth]] issue of the ''[[Star Wars Helmet Collection]]'' magazine produced by [[De Agostini]], published on [[May 6]], [[2015]],{{HCdatesFR|19}} and written by [[Iain Lowson]].{{EmailCite|email=File:HCSV-Email-2025-07-26.png|author=[[Iain Lowson]]|date=2025-07-26}} That name originated in [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] through [[Decipher]]'s [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]], where it appeared on the [https://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/JabbasPalace-Dark/large/vizam.gif "Vizam" card] in the [[1998]] ''[[Jabba's Palace Limited]]'' set.{{CCG|set=Jabba's Palace Limited|cardname=Vizam}} The [[2018]] reference book [[Star Wars: Complete Vehicles (2018)|''Star Wars: Complete Vehicles'']] uses Vizam's character design for the majority of guards on board the ''Khetanna''. ===Visions=== [[File:VizamVisions-TR.png|thumb|left|300px|Vizam transported members of the band Star Waver on a skiff to their performance in the Mos Espa Grand Arena.]] Vizam appears in "[[Tatooine Rhapsody]]," a non-canon short film in the ''[[Star Wars: Visions]]'' series{{Visions|Tatooine Rhapsody}} released on [[September 22]], [[2021]].{{SWYouTube|b9Gr9gKFxpE|STAR WARS: VISIONS | SPECIAL LOOK | DISNEY+|sw_url=video/special-look-star-wars-visions}} In the short, the band [[Star Waver]] make a deal to perform for Jabba in the [[Mos Espa Grand Arena]] before he executes one of their members, [[Geezer Odajion]].{{SWCT|set=2022 Base - Series 2|cardname=Geezer Odajion}} Vizam pilots a Bantha-II cargo skiff to the arena's stage carrying two [[Gamorrean]]s and three members of the band; Odajion, [[K-344]], and [[V-5]]. He then moves the vehicle away from the stage while the song "[[Galactic Dreamer]]" is performed, but returns at the end of song transporting the armed guards Vedain, [[Kithaba]], and [[Rintel Aren]].{{EncyclopediaCite|The Battle of Hoth and the Second Death Star}} Star Waver's lead singer, [[Jee Ken Tsokee|Jay]], then asks Jabba to spare Odajion and instead become the band's first sponsor. After the crowd demand an encore, the guards on Vizam's skiff aim their blasters at the band, but then shoulder them on Jabba's signal to spare Odajion. Vizam then pilots the skiff away, allowing the band to perform again. ===LEGO=== [[File:VizamSarlacc-LSS.png|thumb|right|300px|Vizam (left) is grabbed by the sarlacc in ''LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga''.]] In the non-canon [[2022]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]'', Vizam appears in the mission "The Copa-Khetanna." He is first shown standing with a [[vibro-ax]] on the skiff carrying Skywalker and the other prisoners above the sarlacc pit. One of the sarlacc's [[Limb|tentacles]] then taps Vizam's shoulder, distracting him so that it can grab the Nikto and drag him screaming into the sarlacc pit as C-3PO speaks to the prisoners. The Vizam model is then used as one of several repeated generic enemy model onboard the ''Khetanna''.''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]'' Vizam also appears in the non-canon LEGO short "[[Jabba's Halloween Bash]]," which was released on [[October 5]], [[2024]], as part of ''[[LEGO STAR WARS: Celebrate the Season]]''. In the short, he is shown attending a [[Halloween]] party Jabba is throwing on the ''Khetanna'' over the Great Pit of Carkoon and is present in the rear interior when a guest in the [[Darth Vader's armor|armor]]{{SWKidsYouTube|c0qF6KUvfSw|Lego Star Wars - Jabba's Halloween Bash | Celebrate the Season}} of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] arrives and begins to intimidate the other guests. After the real Vader arrives at the party, the imposter is revealed to be Bib Fortuna and he is taken out onto a Bantha-II cargo skiff by Vizam, Kithaba, and a Gamorrean. Vizam and Kithaba stand on the skiff as the Gamorrean prods Fortuna off the end of the skiff's gangplank with a [[spear]], leaving hanging off the end of the plank over the sarlacc's maw. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Vizam}} *''[[The Skywalker Saga]]'' *[[Star Wars (LINE Webtoon)|''Star Wars'' LINE Webtoon]] *[[Han Solo & Chewbacca 1|''Han Solo & Chewbacca'' 1]] *[[Han Solo & Chewbacca 5|''Han Solo & Chewbacca'' 5]] {{Mo}} *''[[Star Wars Treasury: The Original Trilogy]]'' *{{Film|VI}} {{1st}} *[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (paperback novel)|''Star Wars: Return of the Jedi'' junior novelization]] *[[Return of the Jedi Read-Along Storybook and CD|''Return of the Jedi'' Read-Along Storybook and CD]] *[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (Disney Die-Cut Classics)|''Star Wars: Return of the Jedi'' die-cut children's book]] ===Non-canon appearances=== *{{Visions|Tatooine Rhapsody}} *''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]'' *{{CelebrateTheSeason|Jabba's Halloween Bash}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars Costumes: The Original Trilogy]]'' *{{HelmetCollectionCite|19|Weapons & Uniforms}} {{1stID|Vizam}} *''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded]]'' {{Po}} *[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A -
